repository.worktree: shared dirty WIP; acceptance changed evidence only

findings: the four scoped collaboration ID sites reuse createCorrelationId and remove UUID dashes at their existing boundaries
createCorrelationId retains crypto.randomUUID when available and uses crypto.getRandomValues for a UUIDv4 fallback
the fallback sets version 4 and RFC variant bits and contains no Math.random fallback
the chat regression now proves both Connected Hub send and Disconnected REST fallback are invoked when randomUUID is absent
no Hub lifecycle, implicit-start, or five-second retry wrapper was restored
mock-backed tests reach the existing Hub and REST call boundaries
media request and negotiation IDs use the same secure UUID helper
no real LAN HTTP request, Hub negotiate, WebSocket, or WebRTC signalling was observed in this acceptance
Huawei or Android device page was not reachable for this acceptance
trusted HTTPS, device permissions, actual audio playback, and actual screen capture remain field checks
Android Chrome screen-capture API absence is a browser capability boundary, not proof of an application defect

checks: isSecureContext === false produces MEDIA_SECURE_CONTEXT_REQUIRED before local screen or microphone capture
the technical code maps to zh-CN and en-US localized messages
screen capture checks getDisplayMedia and microphone capture checks getUserMedia independently
missing getDisplayMedia does not block voice capture
remote viewing does not call the local startScreenCapture entry and therefore does not require local getDisplayMedia
screen and microphone capture remain at the beginning of their user-click paths before network invitation
